title: Notifications & WhatsApp Hub
subtitle: Manage your Evolution API WhatsApp instance, configure automated messages, and monitor delivery queue.

connection.title: Evolution API Instance (WhatsApp)
connection.description: Connect your WhatsApp number to send workout links, health anamnesis forms, and automatic alerts to your students.
connection.step2: Tap Linked Devices or WhatsApp Web
connection.step3: Point your camera at the QR code to synchronize
connection.connectedMessage: Your instance is active and ready to dispatch messages!
connection.disconnectConfirm: Are you sure you want to disconnect this WhatsApp instance? Automated notifications will pause until reconnected.
connection.testModalSubtitle: Send an instant message to verify that Evolution API is delivering correctly.

automations.title: Automated Message Triggers
automations.description: Configure which WhatsApp notifications will be automatically triggered when key events occur.
automations.welcomeDesc: Automatically sent when a new student or lead is registered, including their unique health anamnesis link.
automations.workoutDesc: Dispatched when you publish or update a student's workout routine, providing instant web player access.
automations.expirationDesc: Notifies the student 3 days before their plan or routine expires for seamless renewal.
automations.dndDesc: Messages triggered between 22:00 and 08:00 (Brasília time) are safely queued and dispatched starting at 08:00 AM.

queue.title: Dispatch Queue & History
queue.subtitle: View queued messages, delivery logs, retry failed messages, or cancel pending notifications.
